title: Leonida Nights
note: Names and descriptions are the official English text as shown on PlayStation Network. Rockstar has not published an official list; names are cross-checked across PowerPyx, GTABase, EGamers.io, Push Square and Exophase. Anything not confirmed in two sources is marked unconfirmed.

stages.name: Story
stages.tagline: Finish the story. Every trophy here is unmissable.

stages.name: Side stories

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies — the Platinum pops automatically.
Finish the story first (Stage 1), then the side stories (Stage 2).
Work the 100% checklist last: A Long Road is the final gate for most players.
Tick trophies off here as they pop and watch the stage bars fill.
trophies.tip: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and about 200 hours. It is long, not hard — no trophy needs online play, a difficulty setting, or mission medals.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing.
Follow the on-screen prompts — it is a tutorial mission.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy. It pops in your first hour.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Complete Chapter 1.
Do not skip Lucia's balcony meditation the morning after Down to Earth — see Positive Mental Attitude.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.tip: Chapter 1 is the only chapter with a possibly missable trophy interaction, so do the balcony meditation before you finish it.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete Chapter 2.
Both Jason and Lucia become playable — the last meditation spot needs both of them, after Coffee Break.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy. Chapter 2 is where most of the map opens up.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Complete Chapter 3.
Small banks open after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check — 14 of them, and the 100% checklist wants all 14.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy. Credit Check unlocks the small-bank robberies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete Chapter 4.
Do the optional mission That's Where The Money Is… before you finish the chapter — it unlocks the 8 large bank vaults.
The trophy pops at the end of the chapter.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy. The optional vault mission is the one thing in Chapter 4 you should not skip.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Complete the final mission.
Keep a manual save from before the final mission — there is no mission replay and no New Game+.
After the credits you return to free roam and the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
trophies.tip: Save before the finale. You cannot replay it, and the post-story cleanup is where the Platinum is won.

trophies.name: Trust
steps: Play the mission Breakfast Run.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy. Mission trophies cannot be missed — just play the story.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play the mission The Cartel Heist.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy. A Chapter 3 mission, per GTABase.

trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Play the mission Child's Play.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Play the mission Headliners.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Play the mission VCIA Takedown.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy. VCIA returns later for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Play the mission Operation Savage Glory.
Follow the mission objectives to the end.
The trophy pops when the mission ends.
trophies.tip: Unmissable story trophy.

trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story — the checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Work it in three parts: 45% Story and Tasks, 45% Exploration and Activities, 10% Discovery.
The big numbers: 300 of 397 stunts, 15 of 18 card sets, 200 of 277 vehicles, 70 of 80 challenges, 100 optional tasks, all 22 bank jobs, all 8 vaults, all 39 gang operations.
Nothing on the checklist is missable — everything can be finished in free roam after the credits.
PowerPyx puts 100% at roughly 60% of true completion — the checklist is lenient by design.
trophies.tip: The hardest trophy by both guides, but only because it is long. Do the story first; everything you did before the credits already counts.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights, 25 base jumps.
Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest — fly a plane under bridges.
The optional challenge on each stunt icon is not needed; doing the stunt once counts.
Track by region under Progress > Activities > Stunts; the map can show every Stunt Spot.
Keep going to 300 — the 100% checklist wants 300.
trophies.tip: Any mix counts. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest route to 250.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool, basketball (sink one basket), playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or Top Fun drone race), and performing a stunt.
Check Progress > Activities to see what is left; the map's blue dumbbell filter shows activity spots.
Most come naturally while chasing the other trophies — do not grind this one first.
trophies.tip: You will do one of each almost by accident while working on the rest of the list.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
steps: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 ranges.
Ranges also raise your Focus level, which helps Gunslinger.
Griffin has 18 challenges and Rodgers Ranch 24 — gold every one.
Track under Progress > Activities.
trophies.tip: 42 golds, no exceptions — the 100% checklist wants all 42 too.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
steps: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations.
One win per location is enough for the trophy, but the 100% checklist wants all 42 races — finish each location while you are there.
There are 3 races per location.
trophies.tip: 14 locations x 3 races = 42 races. Do all three at each stop and the 100% box is ticked too.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Win 20 different races — there are 40 to choose from.
Winning the same race again does not count.
The 100% checklist wants 30 of 40 unique races won, plus 10 of 13 race challenge gold medals.
trophies.tip: Race variety matters, not repeats. Keep winning new ones and the 100% count climbs with you.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
steps: Find Cal and beat him in a fishing challenge.
Fishing is one of the 9 Master of None activity types — this counts toward both.
Check Progress > Activities for the fishing count.
trophies.tip: Fishing spots are marked on the map once you have unfogged the area.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Complete one arcade game.
Arcades are marked on the map; playing a video game is also one of the 9 Master of None types.
The 100% checklist wants 4 of 4 video games played — starting each one is enough.
trophies.tip: One finished game pops the trophy; start the other three for the 100% checklist.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
steps: Meet Andy and play through his mission strand to the final mission.
Start stranger strands early — TechWiser warns their windows can close, though PowerPyx says quest-givers return after the story.
Finish Andy's final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.tip: Time-limited — start early. One of the five stranger finales; the other four are Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
steps: Meet Kenton and play through his mission strand to the final mission.
Start stranger strands early — TechWiser warns their windows can close, though PowerPyx says quest-givers return after the story.
Finish Kenton's final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.tip: Time-limited — start early. One of the five stranger finales.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
steps: Meet Billy and play through his mission strand to the final mission.
Start stranger strands early — TechWiser warns their windows can close, though PowerPyx says quest-givers return after the story.
Finish Billy's final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.tip: Time-limited — start early. One of the five stranger finales.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
steps: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida.
The five named finales (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) count toward it; the rest are found by exploring.
Start strands early — the same window warning applies as to the individual finales.
trophies.tip: Time-limited — start early. The five finales are the backbone; the rest come from exploring Leonida.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
steps: Meet Randy and play through his mission strand to the final mission.
Start stranger strands early — TechWiser warns their windows can close, though PowerPyx says quest-givers return after the story.
Finish Randy's final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.tip: Time-limited — start early. One of the five stranger finales.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
steps: Meet Tyrone and play through his mission strand to the final mission.
Start stranger strands early — TechWiser warns their windows can close, though PowerPyx says quest-givers return after the story.
Finish Tyrone's final mission to pop the trophy.
trophies.tip: Time-limited — start early. One of the five stranger finales.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
steps: Meditate at every spot until the counter reaches 18 — 18 spots at 10 locations.
CHAPTER 1 WARNING: the morning after Down to Earth, follow Lucia from the kitchen to the balcony and accept her meditation. It is gone after Chapter 1.
The balcony session adds +1 to the counter but is not marked as a spot; PowerPyx says it is unconfirmed whether it is required — its author did it and earned the trophy, so do it.
Meditating at a spot with Jason and Lucia together counts twice; the last spot needs both characters, possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2.
Track under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
The 100% checklist needs only 15 of 18 meditations, so 100% is safe either way — only this trophy is at risk.
trophies.tip: The ONLY possibly missable trophy. Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation, keep a manual save at the start of every chapter, and never rely on mission replay — there is none.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
steps: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
The exact animal is not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase — check the Sources tab before you hunt.
Bret's strands also count toward Strangers & Freaks.
The 100% checklist wants Bret's 15 Target Decks — a separate collectible.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed: the animal itself is still being pinned down. Do not trust a single video — wait for two guides to agree.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets.
There are 18 card sets in the game; the 100% checklist wants 15 of them.
Cards are found across Leonida — check Progress > Collections for the sets you have started.
Finish any 3 sets for the trophy, then keep going to 15 for 100%.
trophies.tip: 3 sets pop the trophy; 15 sets are needed for 100%. The sets are the long tail — pick up cards whenever you pass them.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Use WAiNK It at 100 locations.
The 100% checklist wants 100 WAiNK scans too, so this trophy and the checklist finish together.
Scan whenever you see the WAiNK prompt — it adds up fast.
trophies.tip: 100 scans. It is a grind best done while travelling between other objectives.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Complete 50 Challenges.
There are 80 challenges in the game; the 100% checklist wants 70 of them.
Challenges cover combat, driving, exploration and more — check Progress for the full list.
Keep going past 50: 70 is the 100% number.
trophies.tip: 50 of 80 pops the trophy; 70 of 80 is the 100% target. Do not stop at 50.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
steps: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
Bank vault jobs give you 4 stars at once — escaping one with your partner earns this too.
The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
Bring your partner; solo escapes do not count.
trophies.tip: Pair it with Maximum Withdrawal: rob a vault with your partner, then lose the 4 stars together.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
steps: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
Keep the wanted level the whole time — losing it breaks the chain.
Plan the route: three shops close together, partner in tow, fast getaway car.
trophies.tip: Back-to-back means no break in the wanted level. Pick three shops on one street.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Discover 100 vehicles.
The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 vehicle scans, so keep scanning past 100.
Vehicles count when you scan or drive them — check Progress for the count.
Variety helps: new models count, repeats do not.
trophies.tip: 100 for the trophy, 200 of 277 for 100%. Scan everything you drive.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
steps: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
Build Focus at the shooting ranges first — the ranges raise your Focus level.
Find a group of 5 enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it ends.
Crowded gang operations are a good place to try.
trophies.tip: Focus level matters: gold the shooting ranges first, then pick a fight with five enemies in one spot.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
steps: Go to VCIA, Vice City International Airport.
Take a plane and leave without following the normal departure — an unscheduled takeoff.
The trophy pops once you are airborne and clear.
trophies.tip: VCIA is the airport from the Hi-Jacked mission. Return there after the story and steal a plane.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Find a Rhino tank — they show up at high wanted levels.
Take it on: destroy it or take it for a spin.
The trophy pops when the encounter is done.
trophies.tip: Rhinos are the tanks. Push your wanted level up and they will come to you.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
steps: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
Go in quiet: no alarms, no witnesses spotting you.
Small jewelry stores pay $10,000 to $25,000 per job — but the trophy only cares that you were never seen.
If you are spotted, leave and try another store.
trophies.tip: Undetected is the whole trophy. One alarm and the attempt is wasted.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: First do the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is… — vaults do not open before it.
Follow an armored cash truck into a large bank while the guard has the vault open; you cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner.
Rob 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape.
Every vault job gives you 4 stars at once — plan a fast bike for the escape.
The 100% checklist wants all 8 vaults (and all 22 bank jobs: 14 small banks + 8 large).
One large vault can pay up to about $205,000.
trophies.tip: No vaults before Chapter 4's optional mission. Bring your partner, expect 4 stars, and escape with a bike waiting.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
steps: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
Armored trucks roam the roads — hit one and get clear.
The trophy pops once you have left the red heat zone, not just the flashing search area.
A fast bike helps; the heat is instant.
trophies.tip: Same escape rule as Hot Together: clear the red zone, not just the search area.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Explore all of Leonida.
The map starts under fog; it counts once none is left.
A plane, which you can get early in Chapter 1, clears the fog fastest.
Fly or drive the whole map — every region must be uncovered.
trophies.tip: Fog is the enemy. A plane in Chapter 1 clears it fastest.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
steps: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs.
There are 39 illegal gang operation locations across Leonida.
One operation per gang is enough for the trophy; the 100% checklist wants all 39.
Operations are marked once you find them — work gang by gang.
trophies.tip: 9 gangs, 39 operations. One per gang pops the trophy; all 39 are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
steps: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
The exact trigger is not yet confirmed by PowerPyx or GTABase — the description is the only hint so far.
Try the Ocean Beach bars at sunset with a cocktail in hand; check the Sources tab for updates.
Do not trust a single video — wait for two guides to agree.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed. The description is all anyone has; the method will be added once players pin it down.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
steps: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
No confirmed method yet — the description is the only hint.
Likely a showroom smash-and-grab; check the Sources tab for updates.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
steps: Play bowling at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Follow through on a full game — the trophy is about the follow-through, not the score.
Bowling is a minigame like the arcade games in Stick Fiddler.
trophies.tip: One full game at the Kolt & Associates alley.

trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Build a partnership with mass appeal.
The description points at a partnership moment — play the story and side content with your partner.
It pops from a partnership milestone, not a grind.
trophies.tip: Story-adjacent: keep playing with your partner and it will come.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Make choices — for better or worse.
PSN tracks a count toward 500 choices.
Choices happen across missions and free roam; keep playing and the count climbs.
trophies.tip: A slow burn: 500 choices tracked by PSN. It pops while you play everything else.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Second time's the charm.
No confirmed method yet — the name suggests succeeding on a second attempt at something.
Check the Sources tab; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed. The description is the only hint.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Witness something strange.
No confirmed method yet — the name points at a UFO or strange-encounter moment.
Explore the odd corners of Leonida; check the Sources tab for updates.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed — PowerPyx marks it not yet known.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
steps: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
No confirmed method yet — the description suggests knocking someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle.
Check the Sources tab; PowerPyx marks it not yet known.
trophies.tip: Unconfirmed. The description is the only hint — a melee drive-by, not a bowling score.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
steps: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
Marked Bills come from robberies — fence them through contacts, not shops.
The 100% checklist also wants $100,000 of narcotics fenced, so laundering and fencing go together.
Keep robbing and laundering; the total climbs with every job.
trophies.tip: $250,000 laundered. Robberies feed it — vaults pay up to $205,000 a job.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Spend $100,000 across all shops.
Any shop spending counts — clothes, food, gear.
It adds up while you play; do not grind it early when money is tight.
trophies.tip: $100,000 across all shops. Let it happen naturally; check Progress for the running total.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Buy all 8 garage properties in the Vice City Real Estate app.
The app unlocks after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver.
Together the 8 garages cost about $160,000.
Garages the story gives you do not count — only the 8 you buy.
trophies.tip: 8 garages, about $160,000. Buy them after Daily Driver; the 4 story garages do not count.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
steps: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
Each car needs a free garage space, so buy garages first.
Register cheap cars — any 10 vehicles count.
Pair with Little Boxes: garages first, then register.
trophies.tip: 10 vehicles, and each needs a free garage space. Garages first, registrations second.
